_about: Voter-footprint SEIFA per federal booth: vote-weighted mean SEIFA scores over the SA1s where the booth's VOTERS live (AEC 'Votes by SA1' roll mark-off x results product — AEC-flagged indicative, rounded), the footprint complement to the venue-proxy store booth-seifa-YYYY.json (SA1 of the premises). Votes SA1s are ASGS Ed1. Scores are SEIFA 2016: each 2011 SA1's votes are redistributed over 2016 SA1s by the ABS CG_SA1_2011_SA1_2016 correspondence (its population ratios) – the election fell five weeks before the 2016 census. Per-index ABS suppression: each index weights over its own covered votes (cov). Sentinel …9999 no-address SA1s are vote-counted but score-excluded. pp_id 0 rows are division declaration cohorts (Postal/Pre-Poll/Absent/Provisional), emitted per division, not per booth. Booths the votes file never lists (unused PPVCs, cancelled mobile teams) carry votes:null and note:noVotesRows. The divisions array re-pools every unit's per-SA1 demo tallies by division: one language/foreign-born/university/blue-collar/age/income reading per division plus the curated birthplace-country (cob) shares (same country-stated basis as fborn; country order in cobKeys), its shares from its own pooled sum, never from averaging the row-level rounded shares. The demo block folds the 2021-census GCP G01, G09F/G09G/G09H, G49B, G32/G33 and G60B SA1 tables (G01: age-band structure; language spoken at home English-only vs other. G09: country of birth — the overseas-born share excludes country-of-birth-not-stated, and the ten curated birthplace-country shares (cob, country order in cobKeys) ride the same country-stated basis. G49B: highest non-school qualification — the bachelor-and-above share is of the G01 aged-15-and-over population, excluding level-of-education-not-stated. G33 households by weekly income are re-weighted to ADULTS at the data/income-dist.json factors — each band's family households at that band's G32 family mix in the SA1 (national mix as fallback), non-family households at the national mean; loinc is the adult share below the national 25th-percentile weekly household-income cut the store-level incomeCuts record carries (the national histogram's cut band split linearly), hiinc the adult share in the $4,000-and-top band, incMed the band-interpolated median weekly household income in 2021 dollars on the HOUSEHOLD basis (ABS's own published-median basis — the adults-weighted histogram would read ~$300 higher, skewed by couples). G60B: occupation of employed persons — the blue-collar share counts the technicians-and-trades, machinery-operators-and-drivers and labourers major groups over the eight stated occupation groups, excluding inadequately-described/not-stated) — all by the same per-SA1 vote weights — age shares renormalise over the 11 bands, which exclude age-not-stated; persons are a vote-weighted pseudo-population, never a headcount, and demo figures describe where the booth's voters lived in 2021, never who the voters themselves were — the ecological transport is the point of the weighting and its limit. Walk used for this lane: CG_SA1_2011_SA1_2016 composed with CG_SA1_2016_SA1_2021 (the SEIFA lane for this year walks onto 2016 SA1s for the 2016 census; demo is 2021-census based instead). The demoI blocks interpolate the people figures between the 2011 and 2016 censuses to election day (day-share 0.979201 of the intercensal span — the SEIFA pcti lanes' own factors): each demoI lane blends the shares of this election's votes folded on both censuses, a lane missing on either side falling back to the measured demo figure for that lane; incMed and the incomeCutsI dollar figures come from the 2016 census side alone, never a mixed-currency blend.

sourceUrls.bcpInterp: ABS 2011 Census Basic Community Profile, SA1 for AUST (B01/B09/B26/B28/B40B/B45B)

demoBasis: 2021 Census GCP G01, G09F/G09G/G09H, G49B, G32/G33 and G60B @ SA1 (Ed3); every lane's votes are in Ed3 space before folding, walking older geographies via ABS correspondences

demoInterp.nullRule: a unit missing its demo block on either census side, or a lane missing on either side, shows the measured figure instead
